name: Mattermost
description: Mattermost is an open-source team messaging platform built for organizations that want to host and control their own chat infrastructure.
best_for: Positioned as a collaboration platform for mission-critical work — defense, government, critical infrastructure, DevSecOps, and security-operations teams needing data sovereignty.
features: Channels for secure messaging and collaboration
Calls with screenshare, transcription, and summarization
AI agents connectable to sovereign or private LLMs
Pre-built integrations for SIEM/SOAR and DevSecOps tooling

alternatives.name: Slack
alternatives.description: A workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, integrations, and searchable conversations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prefer a fully managed, cloud-hosted chat tool

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, file sharing, and Microsoft 365 integration.

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A community-focused communication platform with text channels, voice rooms, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Communities that value voice chat over self-hosting

pricing.starting_price: Contact sales for paid Professional/Enterprise subscriptions

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Paid self-hosted subscription; public numeric price not shown.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Paid self-hosted subscription; public numeric price not shown.

tiers.name: Enterprise Advanced
tiers.notes: Paid package; public numeric price not shown.

cons: Mattermost does not publish numeric prices for its current paid Professional and Enterprise packages; buyers need to contact sales.
Self-hosted paid subscriptions are sold as prepaid annual seat licenses, and each Mattermost server requires its own license.
